text: 🇲🇽✊ The public bank beat the private remittance houses again. Finabien offered the best exchange rate for remittances: 7,122.36 pesos per $400 — more than the private senders. — Profeco weekly price report, at the mañanera The basic food basket stayed under the agreed 910-peso ceiling at every major chain. Diesel averaged 27.06 pesos/liter, with 83% of stations honoring the price accord. The state competing to lower the cost of living for the people.

🇲🇽🎨 1 in 3 young people have had a romantic relationship with an AI. "33% of these younger generations have sustained a romantic relationship with some kind of Artificial Intelligence agent." — Dr. Cimenna Chao, UNAM psychologist, at the mañanera Presented as evidence in Mexico's new national debate on tech and youth. Young people average 7.32 hours a day online, with rising sleep disruption, anxiety and cyberbullying.

🇲🇽🎨 Regulating tech from below, not by decree. "We want this NOT to be an idea imposed by the government onto society." — Claudia Sheinbaum, launching the national debate on social media The government opened a national debate on how social media and screens affect kids, calling excessive use a form of addiction. Four public forums (Aug–Sep), then an evidence-based bill. 16 Mexican states already ban phones in primary and secondary schools; worldwide, 58% of countries now regulate school device use, up from 24% in 2023 (UNESCO).

🔥🇲🇽 "Absurd, antidemocratic, regressive, Porfirista, conservative." On a PAN youth proposal that only one person per family should vote — or that votes be weighted by education: "Who would agree that only the father of the family votes? What about single mothers, diverse families? ... Absurd, antidemocratic, regressive, Porfirista, conservative and out of touch." — Claudia Sheinbaum Universal suffrage — one citizen, one vote — was won in revolution. Weighting it by family or schooling is a return to the Porfiriato. On restricting the vote by education, she added: "It's contempt for the people."

🇲🇽🌎 Reciprocity, not subordination. "The United States asks for evidence — and we ask for evidence too. We don't want confrontation, we want the mechanisms of a good relationship." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on US relations On bilateral security, she restated the rule that has defined her dealings with Washington: cooperation between equals. Mexico cooperates — and demands the same in return.

🇲🇽🏭 No negotiating tariffs in the middle of a soccer game. "We had the chance to talk trade — but this isn't about holding a meeting on tariffs in the middle of a football match." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on her talk with Trump and Carney Seated between the two North American leaders at the final, she confirmed trade came up but refused to turn a stadium into a negotiating table. Pending issues stay on the formal track: "I told him we have several things pending and I hope we can call each other again or meet."

🇲🇽🌎 Trump invited her personally. She went — on her own terms. "As the saying goes: courtesy doesn't cancel courage." — Claudia Sheinbaum, on the 2026 World Cup final Trump called Saturday and invited her to the final in New York, where Spain beat Argentina. Storms grounded commercial flights, so she flew on a Mexican Air Force plane. She sat with Trump and Canada's Carney — respectful, cordial, and conceding nothing.

🇲🇽📈 15 MONTHS OF EXPANSION — THE DOOM NARRATIVE MEETS THE DATA

The doom narrative keeps colliding with the numbers. INEGI's timely indicator puts Mexican private consumption on track for 15 straight months of expansion — up 2.8% annual in May and 2.6% in June — powered by record-low unemployment and real wages still rising as inflation cools. Households aren't retreating; they're spending. (El Financiero / INEGI)

🔥🇲🇽 MORENA TO THE OPPOSITION: WHERE DID THE HUACHICOL MONEY GO?

Morena wants the FGR and INE to trace whether stolen-fuel money bankrolled the opposition. After Ernesto Ruffo — a Somos México advisory council member — was jailed in Mexico's biggest huachicol case, a Morena senator will ask Congress to investigate if huachicol cash financed the party's creation and PAN campaigns. The bloc that screams "persecution" now has to explain its accounting.

🚨🇲🇽 KIDNAPPED ON MEXICAN SOIL, SENTENCED IN BROOKLYN

A US judge in Brooklyn just sentenced Ismael "El Mayo" Zambada to life — after he was kidnapped on Mexican soil in 2024 and flown to Texas. Contralínea's investigation places DEA and FBI agents in that extrajudicial seizure. Washington calls it justice for "85 crimes"; from Mexico it reads as a foreign agency grabbing a man off sovereign territory and a US court blessing the method.
